words: An approved Plan is never edited
A posted ruling's steps are executed at once
A fix round is followed by a re-review slot item
No PR has a nothing to do state
The owner's call is labelled paused-owner at that moment
One ruling per PR; a further rejection goes to the owner
One verdict per review; a split Plan/Execution verdict counts as changes needed
A review never says a change makes a passage false
No piecemeal makes-false rounds; cut whole sections in one pass
Plan rejected: fix; second rejection: ruling; after a ruling: the owner
A plan-check failure goes back to the same worker
plan-check passes before the PR is marked ready
An approved Plan's commands run as written
A Plan row names the whole command of its Evidence line
CI evidence is a pointer to the head's run
The Execution review waits for full green CI on the reviewed head
After a merge of main the review covers only the resolution
Impossibility needs evidence first
Done-when appears only in the ticket body and changes only before a worker started
A Done-when must be X demonstrated by Y
A PR that closes several tickets needs a recorded ruling
An approved Plan is never judged again by the Plan-row rule
A review lists every finding in round one
Every escalation carries a How we got here section
An extra file found in review is removed and gets a .gitignore line
No line is added to any .md or .rst file
Docs that restate code are removed
A PR body never carries the harness's session URL footer
A relock and zip-only head needs no review

A started PR gets nothing added

No bundled shims for weak engines
No path outside the repository in a Plan row: no scratchpad, home or system-root path; the data lives in the PR or the ticket

Never tell the owner nothing is running
The coordinator corrects a message that says the slot is idle
Re-run slots next before each dispatch
Only briefs pitboss prints; no hand-typed brief paths
One ticket, one PR, one task per ticket
Fold the newer ticket into the older
Order: running workers, PRs before tickets, priority, age
A blocker inherits the blocked item's rank
The task list is real state
The checklist lists every running agent
The check-in job is kept; a lapsed check-in is flagged
pitboss nox before every push is plenty; it is a maximum, not a target
Workers use their own worktree on the ticket's branch
Workers change files with the Edit tool only
A partial hand-back is refused unless Impossible: cmd -> output
Every hand-back and every disk clean is logged once
Pitboss's own PRs are never drafts
A runner-pressure hold covers pushes, merges and dispatches
A worker never changes a PR's draft state
Stuck GitHub runs are root-caused, not waited on
Another session's agents survive a restart and can duplicate a ticket
Never sit in a long wait; no polling
After a worker opens a PR, read the body footer and the text-lint status
A PR body edit keeps the Head: line and expand blocks in step with the head
Clean the disk without asking, harder over 90 percent
Never remove files under /dev
A merged worktree goes on merge
Never re-run CI to get rid of a flake; root-cause a failure from its log (a re-run that works around a GitHub problem is allowed)
Failed-check details are read through the API
A flake is never closed until addressed
A relock with green CI and pins-check OK merges with no review and ranks last
An unset secret fails
The sweep lists every org repo
The sweep and slots run from the newest pitboss
Everything the orchestrator creates is synced
A stale remote branch or scratch PR is flagged and closed
A re-run is refused only when it is to get rid of a flake; a re-run that works around a GitHub problem (a run stuck queued with no jobs) is allowed
Run pitboss, check its output, override a known bug disclosed
Do not report pitboss bugs to the coordinator; diagnose and file
The orchestrator owns pitboss and never waits for the owner on a pitboss decision
Never say I haven't checked
Every correction states its prevention
Rules go to memory and a pitboss ticket, never a skill or an md line
Never assume the owner acted
Ruling comments are standing-approved
Every question to the owner comes with a markdown artifact
Artifact and log reads of CI go through the new-environment thread

The owner stays private

A thread attaches a missing repo itself
Never resolve a human decision card

plan-check --post writes the Plan check comment itself
After a revise the plan ruling the review is offered, never a Plan rewrite
A relock review runs with pins-review outside the slot and ranks last
A comment mention of a ticket does not take it
A resolver error in a package install is not this PR's; the next push re-runs it
A Plan check newer than the ruling at the head is offered the review, with both times
A PR with an open blocker has no step
Evidence blocks name the body's head; a push that moves the head says to expand again
A review of an approved Plan has an Execution line; one without is named REVIEW UNREAD
ci-run compares a Plan's run with the head it was approved at
hand-back-check reads the repository from the worktree's origin; pins-review leaves the clone on its branch
A Plan check newer than the ruling is reviewed; --force --step review prints the review brief
A run queued over 30 minutes while later runs completed is STUCK CI
Every running agent counts toward the cap, a diagnosis included
A fix round waits at most 30 minutes; a review starts on green CI; no made false
A cancelled run, or a failure followed by a later success of the same check, is finished and not red
A ruling's steps are counted done after a body-only fix round with a clean Plan check, and the review brief is printed for a named PR
A PR whose newest head has a failing check is offered a fix that names the check and its job, not a review
A posted do-these-steps ruling voids the earlier approval and prints the fix-round brief
A Plan whose digest changed after its approval is executed when a ruling follows, and changed run URLs alone are no edit
A draft whose Plan was rejected gets the revision round and then the Opus ruling, never the Plan review again
plan-check refuses a Plan with a Done-when item that has no demonstrated-by pairing
The fragment check refuses a cut line that starts with any closing mark by its Unicode category
hand-back-check names the owner's allowance when a worker stops at a repository rule that forbids the feature
pitboss body-head prints the merge-proof pair from the body last Head, not from the reviewed SHA
pitboss lint refuses a body whose `git rev-parse HEAD` Evidence block differs from the last Head line
The "revise the plan" brief asks for an empty commit; a Plan-only revision needs no new head
An Opus ruling at the Plan stage does not exhaust the Execution stage's rounds: the first Execution rejection is fixed against the Plan, not escalated to the owner
plan-check refuses a Plan whose change adds a config table or key that doc/example.toml does not list
The worker brief asks a new syntax scan to plant one input for each spelling of every form its Done-when names
The phrase lint exempts a verbatim copy of the ticket's Done-when
The review brief refuses a deviation from a Done-when item that is a scheduling constraint, not an impossibility
pitboss next reports MISSING NAMES for a Done-when name that is not a path (an allowlist line key)
pitboss lint pr-body refuses the Evidence of a pull request made by a reviewed script (tools/adopt)
markup-lines refuses a generated report that a script writes
The PR-body lint reads the lines inside pitboss-expand blocks, so a words check refuses a Plan-mandated git diff row
A Plan whose commands run in a scratch path must make or show that path's state, and a timed row must give its limit
Drop the acceptance of Plan digests recorded before pitboss#358 collapsed expanded blocks
Add `pitboss lint e2e-waits`: refuse fixed waits and nameless quarantine marks in end-to-end tests
Rules: quarantine a failing test at its p0 ticket, and merge a race fix only with its evidence
Add the quarantine and race forms to `pitboss lint pr-body|review|brief`
Add a review-comment check: refuse an approval of a head with no completed green check run
Add `pitboss lint pins`: the CI-input pinning rules of `bats check-pins`
Remove from the sweep skill what the commands made unneeded
Move what a command can say from the sweep skill into the commands
The orchestrator never resolves a human decision card; the sweep skill says so
pitboss ticket-find prints the open tickets close to a new one before it is filed, and a filing refuses a ticket with no check
The orchestrator skill forbids ending an answer with "I haven't checked": do the check first
Generalize the orchestration rules learned on bats-lang/quire into the sweep skill
Orchestration rules as they stand on 2026-10-24: update pitboss's defaults and docs to match
Rules: short jobs run locally, CI runs the rest, no background runs and no sleep loops
Rules: a ticket without a priority label gets one by the criteria, then the order is strict
rules.md "Plan first" says an Opus ruling is unrestricted
Rules: an Opus ruling carries the owner's authority, priority change and duplicate close included
A design for an umbrella ticket names, for each guarantee, the function, file and test that enforce it, and a lifecycle list for each new atom, store or element
sweep classifies a mechanical red and a push that fixes it is exempt from the runner hold
Add a tracked pre-push hook that runs the project's configured first-minute checks
Add sweep lines HOOKS-NOT-INSTALLED and NO-VERIFY, and make the push command load the project's env file
Runner-pressure holds apply only to repos of the org whose runners are busy
brieftext.py CI_DRAFT says a draft has no check run, which is the claim pitboss#277 removes
pitboss deletes stale remote branches: a command the owner runs from a machine with push rights
Remove the positional configuration argument of the pitboss commands (after #307's overlap)
pitboss nox passes on the branch alone while CI tests the PR merged with main
The relock review brief names a case for a test fix that the new pin needs
sweep reports a failed publish run with its failing step and the check that caused it
Never quarantine or skip a test to get green
Two rules of the register that contradict each have a declared resolution, and a PR that hits one that is a ruling gets the Opus ruling brief, never UNKNOWN or a question to the owner

Every state-changing action on a PR (push, merge, undraft, dispatch, close, label) has a cell for every step and task in the state x action matrix, and every action word the register uses is an action or marked exempt
A state-changing action goes through pitboss act, which refuses what the PR's step does not allow, and the sweep names each GitHub event of these kinds that no act record answers
A body whose Head line, or an Evidence block, names an older head than the PR's has a printed step that rewrites it and validates it with lint pr-body
A grade line is read as written by the form check and the sweep alike: a trailing full stop or space grades, bold, other case and a space before the colon are refused with the accepted words printed

A check red on two or more open PRs of a repository, or on main and a PR, with the same first error line is reported once as SHARED RED, the lowest PR is offered one ticket step, the others wait, and no per-PR fix is offered

A PR may declare Blocked-by: owner/name#N, one line for each blocker: while one is open the PR waits (no fix, review or merge is offered), a loop or a blocker closed unmerged is refused by name, and when every blocker has merged after the red check the PR is told to merge the base and push

A review brief carries the repository CLAUDE.md rules that name Verdict: changes needed and the kinds of its adversarial review, and lint repo-rules flags a new shell script or a multi-command workflow step in a repository that writes bats, not shell, unless the body names the avenue

Every review brief prints the exact grade lines, the accepted words and the --review-kind of its kind, lint review refuses a review that lacks a grade line its kind needs naming the line and the words, and the sweep says REVIEW UNREAD for a review of an approved Plan with no Execution line

A PR a worker handed back unfinished (no clean Plan check, a refused Plan check, or a red text-lint status on a PR to review or merge) is offered the step FINISH_PARTIAL, resumed on the same PR, oldest first ahead of new tickets, a PR a slot holds is not offered again, and the sweep names any PR that is offered for nothing

The worker brief lists the file-specific gates of the files the ticket's Done-when names (a workflow the default branch runs needs a cited run of the scratch repository, a change to src needs a regenerated bootstrap/c, each made from a sentence of the repository's CLAUDE.md), and plan-check refuses a Plan with no row for a gate that applies to a changed file, naming the gate and the row form

Every task, step and action has a gate row (hold, pressure or free with its reason) and a test that shows it, a step that may arm, merge, undraft, dispatch or push is never free, the sweep names a PR dropped from the merge queue, and the re-arm of auto-merge is withheld by a runner hold or its quiet period like the merge and offered after it

Every rule line of the owner's project memory and every correction of ticket 444 is mapped in clauses.tsv to rules of the register that are enforced and hold its word, or to outside with a reason, and pitboss clauses check lists any clause with no row

A step that spends runner time (undraft, merge, arm, dispatch, the e2e run, a relock dispatch) is withheld while a cheap check of the head is red and known (text-lint, the review gate, canonical-files, the Plan check, the review form, the pins-check), the sweep, slots next and act print one FIX FIRST line that names the red and the step that fixes it, every spending row of actiongates.tsv against every known-red row is tested, and the step is offered again once the red is cleared

Every claim a worker or a command reports (pushed to a branch, the head is a commit, the body's Head line, CI green, the Plan check posted, a comment posted, a label set, undrafted, merged, the branch restarted from main) has a row in claims.tsv with the GitHub fact it is read back from, pitboss push reads the PR of the ticket back (WRONG-BRANCH, push NOT LANDED), hand-back-check refuses a PR whose head branch is not the one pushed, pitboss act reads the PR after an action (act NOT LANDED), and the sweep names a PR whose body names another head (STALE-CLAIM)
A printed brief never tells an agent to do what a rule forbids; a body-only Plan revision pushes nothing

Every approval, verdict or check stored against a digest or a head (the Plan approval against the Plan digest, the Execution approval against the head, the plan-check against the Plan digest, a review against the body digest) is read through current-for, none outlives the subject it was about, and a Plan revised after its approval or after a revise-the-plan ruling prints a Plan re-review step

Every gate that is a command (a repository pre-push check, a nox session) passes only on an explicit ok: a non-zero status, a crash, an unbound-variable text, an empty output, a timeout and a missing argument each refuse, and the pre-push check of a repository takes its arguments from the declared check or the push is refused naming them
